simulation: Normal scene and physics clock, fixed at 60 Hz, isolated profile. The fixture positions the avatar at each real interaction. Player-supply phases park the rescued forester after its first normal delivery to isolate its optional second source of legitimate input. A separate live survivor route exercises the courier.
circulation: Collision queries sampled the inside of the final perimeter at 0.26 m pitch with a 0.96 m diameter capsule. Gate crossing checks moved the actual character body through each open gate in both directions.
cold_failure_paths: Held a live save lock during worker delivery, automatic cook completion, customer checkout and level transition. Prior payload SHA-256 matched exactly; fresh retries committed once.
bounds: These tests verify game logic and walkable clearance. Render style, camera framing and target-device frame rate require separate review.
saw_camera: At 1x and 2x the camera-facing rear cutaway removed the occluding roof, lowered the rear wall and kept the door and collider closed. Leaving the west saw restored the full roof and wall.
